Shapes recorded from https://api.bgm.tv/v0 (public data) by scripts/record-bangumi-fixtures.mjs, then made anonymous: the user is the invented `reader`, every `updated_at` in the 1019-row list is moved by a fixed amount, comments are the recorder's made-up ones and summaries replaced with 「（示例简介）」. Subject ids and names are public catalogue facts.

`reader-done-dates.json`: 1019 看过 cut down to subject id, subject type, `updated_at`, name_cn, name and air date. It keeps the date shape the tests check (one big pile-up, a busy day under the pile-up ratio).
